title: Methodology and limitations

dataset.name: Zomato restaurant listing dataset (zomato.csv) with Country-Code.xlsx
dataset.status: Publicly circulated secondary data; a single undated (historical) snapshot. This website is a historical research benchmark, not a live Zomato service.

funnel.note: Single currency; 38 of 43 cities have every restaurant rated
New Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Faridabad, Ghaziabad

threshold_pattern.text: Every listing with 0-3 votes shows a rating of 0 and every listing with 4+ votes has a positive rating, with no exception. This is an observed pattern consistent with a rating-publication threshold; it is not confirmed Zomato policy. A zero rating means 'no published rating', never zero quality.

outcomes.name: Visibility
outcomes.measure: is_rated = 1 if the rating is above zero

outcomes.name: Perceived quality
outcomes.measure: Displayed aggregate rating (1.8-4.9 in rated NCR)

outcomes.name: Customer engagement
outcomes.measure: log(1 + Votes); votes are an engagement proxy, not satisfaction
outcomes.model: OLS, HC3 robust errors (% difference in the geometric mean of 1 + Votes)

specification: outcome ~ online delivery + table booking + price tier (categorical) + cuisine breadth + chain (5+ outlets) + city fixed effects

analyses.name: Regression models
analyses.text: Three models with a common right-hand side so that associations can be compared across outcomes; Model 3b re-estimates engagement on all NCR as a sensitivity check.

analyses.name: Robustness checks
analyses.text: India-wide replication (R1), log cost for two in place of price tier (R2), excluding placeholder-coordinate rows (R3), excluding the most influential 1% (R4), a top-tercile engagement indicator (R5), chain thresholds of 3, 5, 8 and 10 outlets.

analyses.name: Performance analysis
analyses.text: Top and bottom 10% by rating (rated NCR) and by votes (all NCR and rated NCR, never pooled), with Benjamini-Hochberg corrected tests, effect sizes and adjusted extreme-group logits.

analyses.name: City analysis
analyses.text: Five-city profiles with Wilson and bootstrap intervals, tests with and without Ghaziabad, city-specific models for four cities and predictor x city interaction tests.

analyses.name: Locality analysis
analyses.text: City + Locality units with at least 30 restaurants (sensitivity 20 and 50); rating statistics need at least 20 rated restaurants; locality fixed effects compared with city fixed effects by nested tests.

limitations.title: Observational design
limitations.text: Every result is an association in a single cross-section; reverse causality is plausible and no causal effect is identified.

limitations.title: Votes are a proxy
limitations.text: Votes capture one behavioural dimension of engagement and also reflect exposure and time on the platform. They are not a measure of customer satisfaction or sales.

limitations.title: Zero rating is not zero quality
limitations.text: Restaurants without a published rating are excluded from rating statistics, never averaged in as low scores.

limitations.title: Publication threshold not confirmed
limitations.text: The 0-3 / 4+ vote pattern is inferred from a perfect empirical separation, not verified against platform documentation.

limitations.title: Historical data
limitations.text: The snapshot is undated. The platform, its rating rules and the NCR market may have changed, so these benchmarks do not describe the current platform.

limitations.title: Not nationally representative
limitations.text: The analysis covers Delhi NCR only; findings should not be generalised to India.

limitations.title: Small Ghaziabad sample
limitations.text: Ghaziabad has 25 restaurants (23 rated) and no eligible locality; its values are shown but not interpreted.

limitations.title: Uneven locality coverage
limitations.text: 74 of the 98 eligible localities are in New Delhi; Faridabad has one and Ghaziabad none. Ranks near the threshold are imprecise and threshold-sensitive.

limitations.title: Locality effects bundle many factors
limitations.text: Locality differences combine footfall, demographics, rents and restaurant mix; they are not effects of location itself.

limitations.title: Omitted variables
limitations.text: Listing age, food, service, ambience and review text are unobserved; the rating model explains only 13% of rating variance.

limitations.title: Outlet-based chain proxy
limitations.text: The chain indicator counts names appearing 5+ times in the snapshot; it is not corporate ownership.
